description: A large dark-hulled ship with a white superstructure, lattice masts and radar or antenna towers, ploughing bow-first through broken blue-white ice floes in a rough grey sea under heavy dark clouds with a sun glow at the upper left. Mid-century styling, no visible letters or numbers, and only a small white emblem on the bow. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame or border, and nothing is gory or nude.
